memories.content: Donald Trump is the Republican Party's presidential nominee. He has been invited to the Al Smith Memorial Foundation Dinner on October 20, 2016. He has not yet confirmed attendance. He may consider the political implications and his schedule.

The Al Smith Memorial Foundation Dinner is a charitable event held annually in New York City, traditionally attended by major-party presidential candidates. The dinner is scheduled for October 20, 2016. Both major-party nominees have been invited. As of October 1, 2016, neither has publicly confirmed whether they will attend in person.
